title: Confirmation lines use medium weight and grey as specified
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, and an inactive part, part B, for this test.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
  6. Click Cancel.
  7. Click the Inactive tab.
  8. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box again.
  9. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
  10. Click Activate parts.
  11. Click the part B row.
  12. Click Activate on the dark bar.
  13. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 3:

  • Inactive is picked.

Step 4:

  • "Existing records that use it stay as they are." is medium weight (a little bolder than the other lines).
  • "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." is grey.
  • The part line and the "This part won't show up" line are regular weight in the normal dark text colour.

Step 5:

  • The confirmation closes.

Step 6:

  • The window closes.

Step 7:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 8:

  • Part B is listed.

Step 9:

  • The menu opens.

Step 10:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 11:

  • The bar reads 1 selected.

Step 12:

  • "Existing records that use it stay as they are." is medium weight; "1 part selected." and "This part can be added to new work again." are regular weight in the normal dark text colour.

Step 13:

  • The confirmation closes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R9: “The "Existing records that use ..." line is medium weight. The "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." line is grey. Every other line is regular weight in the default text color.”
  • S10-R8: “For a reactivation from the bulk bar, the confirmation states "These parts can be added to new work again." ("This part ..." for one), followed by "Existing records that use them stay as they are." ("... that use it ..." for one).”
